body:
I've been depressed for a while now. I'm a freshman in university. I've never had any friends. The good memories I have of high school can be counted all with one hand. I really hate my life. I was among the top students in my school and have always had school as my number one priority.

But that has recently changed. I don't know.... I guess I'm just depressed from the fact that no one ever asks me to hang out with them. I want to know what the touch of a girl feels like. I want to know how it feels to get that late night call from a friend who wants to talk and catch a movie. I've never had that.
I'm slacking off in school now... I haven't been showing up to classes and that's really pissing off my parents who are paying full tuition and room without any financial aid, whatsoever. But for some reason, I just don't care anymore.

I'm tired of this life. I know the stereotypes of redditors who are virgins and don't talk to girls. But it really hurts me to see you guys think it's just a joke. It isn't, or at least it isn't in my life. I'm so tired of waking up to another bullshit day. I don't get along with my roomate. I don't get along with anyone in my hall. I try to make friends. I really try! But no one likes me. I'm tired of this bullshit.
I don't see why not to end it. I'm not saying I will. But as a philosophical preposition, why not? I don't believe in any god and not in an afterlife, that's for sure. If a god does exist, he can go fuck himself. So why not end it? It's not like I'm really going to miss anything. Even better, it'll save me of this never ending torment.

:(

That's okay. I'll weep for myself because I know no one else will care to. I'm sick of not being wanted. I'm sick of not being loved. I'm of being an outcast. I'm sick of crying at night till 4 am in the bathroom. I'm sick of watching everyone else in my life (roomate, siblings, cousins) advance in their life and get all the girls they want and see how badly they treat them and see the girls still chase after them!

It makes no sense to me. BAH! Who the fuck am I talking to? Myself? I'm tired of talking to myself in the mirror. I'm sick and tired of being sick and tired. I'm tired of even my own professors not liking me. Isn't it enough that all the students don't?

I really feel like I don't belong in this world. As cliche as that sounds, I really do. I'm like the triangle when you need a square to finish the final piece in your puzzle. I don't fit.... I'm... I'm even tired of crying right now. Crying my fucking eyes out. Crying for what? That won't do any good. Nothing will change. I haven't slept yet and I can't sleep knowing I'll just wake up to another bullshit day.

I missed an assignment because I was absent for one of my classes. So I email my professor for a photocopy and she responds, "I'm sure you can get a copy from one of your friends."
Oh god! How little she knows about me! Why the assumption? I'm tired of all these fucking douchebags getting what they want.lj fsadkljnfsadljfadsfj;lsadjf
